name: io.github.gouranshul/pg-perf-mcp
title: PostgreSQL Performance (read-only)
description: Read-only PostgreSQL performance diagnostics: slow queries, EXPLAIN, index advice, locks, functions

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: The same API key as MCP_API_KEY, sent as a bearer token

api_key.description: The value you set for MCP_API_KEY

runtimeArguments.name: -p
runtimeArguments.description: Publish the MCP endpoint on localhost only

environmentVariables.name: PGPERF_DB_URL
environmentVariables.description: JDBC URL of the database to diagnose. From inside the container, use host.docker.internal for a database on your machine, e.g. jdbc:postgresql://host.docker.internal:5432/mydb

environmentVariables.name: PGPERF_DB_USER
environmentVariables.description: A read-only role with pg_read_all_stats and pg_monitor (see docker/init.sql)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token clients must send, at least 16 characters (32+ random recommended)
